Object.keys, values, entries and
fromEntries

These methods convert own enumerable string-keyed properties into arrays of keys, values or
pairs, and fromEntries builds an object from pairs.
Object එකක keys, values Jහහෝ key-value pairs array එකකට ලබාගෙන්න පුළුවන්. fromEntries
pairs වලින් අලුත් object එකක් හදනවා. Inherited properties Jමයට ඇතුළත් JනාJවේ.

Interview question: Does Object.keys include inherited properties?
Answer: No. It returns own enumerable string-keyed properties.
Practice: Double every value in an object using entries and fromEntries.
